resistor.repair_sop: Route to SMT Rework Station 4. Apply Type 4 solder paste. Place component manually and reflow using hot air pencil at 260C.

electrolytic_capacitor.repair_sop: Route to TH Rework Station 2. Verify polarity markings on silkscreen before insertion. Hand solder leads at 350C. Clean flux residue.

ic_chip.repair_sop: Route to BGA/QFP Rework Station 1. Align pins to pads precisely. Use hot air rework system with specific thermal profile for ATmega series. Perform optical alignment check post-reflow.

led.repair_sop: Route to SMT Rework Station 4. WARNING: Polarity sensitive. Green dot indicates cathode. Reflow at 240C max to avoid thermal damage to lens.

oscillator.repair_sop: Route to SMT Rework Station 3. Hand solder using fine tip. Do not use ultrasonic cleaning post-rework as it may damage the crystal.

connector.repair_sop: Route to TH Rework Station 2. Ensure header is flush with PCB before soldering. Hand solder at 350C.

default.repair_sop: Route to Engineering Review Station. Component ID not found in MES database. Manual evaluation required.
